description:
Idiomatic V binding for the Universal WASM Loader. It wraps the C single-header loader so you call .wasm exports with native V values and !/or error handling.

The hard parts (WIT parsing, Canonical ABI marshalling, cabi_post string returns, version pinning) live once, in the C loader. This repo is a thin wrapper over it (a small C shim + a V module) — built on the wasmtime C API.
name: synapticforge1.uwl
